I made changes 1 and 3. I couldn't push change 5: GitHub won't let the pi-action-agent App push files under `.github/workflows/` without the `workflows` permission. The workflow file is below for you to commit.

**Pushed to this branch** (`docs: rewrite the release steps and describe the release notes format`):
- **CONTRIBUTING "Releases" (1):** now one sequence you can copy and paste: a branch, then `npm version X.Y.Z --no-git-tag-version` (updates both version files), a PR with a `## Release notes` section, squash-merge, an annotated tag on the merge commit, push the tag, then review and publish the draft release. It refers to the major tag as `vN` rather than `v2`, and says releases always go through a PR.
- **New "Release notes" subsection (3):** the Keep a Changelog headings and their order, one bold item per change users can see, `(#issue, fixed in #pr)`, doc links pinned to `blob/vX.Y.Z/`, and no "Full Changelog" link because the workflow adds it.
- **CI workflows table:** has a row for `release.yml`.
- **PR description:** reformatted to match, with a `## Release notes` section the workflow will copy. "After merging" is now just the tag-and-push steps.

`npm run check` passed with the workflow file present. The branch as pushed doesn't contain it, so the docs name `.github/workflows/release.yml` as plain text. The docs test fails on relative links to files that don't exist. Once you've added the file, tell me and I'll turn those mentions into links, or do it yourself.

**To finish 5**, commit this as `.github/workflows/release.yml` on `chore/release-2.3.0`. It runs when you push a `vX.Y.Z` tag, in this order:
1. Checks that the tag matches both version files and that the commit is on `main`.
2. Runs `npm run check`.
3. Creates a draft release from the PR's `## Release notes` section and adds the "Full Changelog" link. If the section is missing, it stops here.
4. Moves `vN` with an annotated tag, but only if this is the latest `vN.*.*` tag.

Making the draft before moving `vN` means a release with no notes stops before users get the new code.

```yaml
name: Release

# Runs when a maintainer pushes a version tag (vX.Y.Z) on the merge commit of a release pull request. See
# "Releases" in CONTRIBUTING.md. The job checks the tag, creates a draft GitHub Release with the notes from
# the pull request, and moves the major tag (vN). A maintainer reviews and publishes the draft.
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+']

permissions:
  contents: write # push the major tag, create the release
  pull-requests: read # read the release notes from the pull request

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # main and all tags

      - name: Check the tag
        run: |
          version="$(jq -r .version package.json)"
          if [ "$TAG" != "v$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag $TAG does not agree with version $version in package.json"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$(jq -r .version package-lock.json)" != "$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::package-lock.json does not have version $version. Use npm version $version --no-git-tag-version"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$GITHUB_SHA" origin/main; then
            echo "::error::Tag $TAG is not on main. Tag the merge commit of the release pull request"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run quality checks
        run: npm run check

      - name: Create the draft release
        run: |
          # The "## Release notes" section of the pull request that merged this commit, up to the next "## ".
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$GITHUB_SHA/pulls" --jq '.[0].body // ""' \
            | tr -d '\r' \
            | awk '/^## Release notes[[:space:]]*$/ { found = 1; next } found && /^## / { exit } found' \
            > notes.md
          if ! grep -q '[^[:space:]]' notes.md; then
            echo "::error::The pull request of $GITHUB_SHA has no \"## Release notes\" section"
            exit 1
          fi
          previous="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' "$GITHUB_SHA^" 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [ -n "$previous" ]; then
            printf '\n**Full Changelog**: %s/%s/compare/%s...%s\n' \
              "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL" "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$previous" "$TAG" >> notes.md
          fi
          gh release create "$TAG" --draft --verify-tag --title "$TAG" --notes-file notes.md
          echo "::notice::Review and publish the draft: $(gh release view "$TAG" --json url --jq .url)"

      - name: Move the major tag
        run: |
          major="${TAG%%.*}"
          latest="$(git tag --list "$major.*.*" --sort=-v:refname | head -n 1)"
          if [ "$latest" != "$TAG" ]; then
            echo "::notice::$latest is later than $TAG, so $major stays where it is"
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git tag --force --annotate "$major" --message "$major" "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git push --force origin "refs/tags/$major"
```

Suggested commit message: `ci: create the draft release and move the major tag when a version tag is pushed`.

**Before you rely on it:**
- **This release is its first run.** Once this PR is merged, pushing `v2.3.0` triggers the workflow. If it fails, you can still do the old manual steps.
- **Tag rulesets.** If you have rulesets that protect `v*` tags, let `github-actions[bot]` force-push `v2`.
